current_example.problem: Calculate the value of $4\div \dfrac35,$ expressing the result as a mixed number.
current_example.worked_solution:
Dividing a whole number by a fraction is equivalent to multiplying the whole number by the reciprocal of the fraction.

First, we write $4$ as an improper fraction:

$$
4=\dfrac{4}{1}
$$

Next, we note that the reciprocal of $\dfrac{\color{blue}3}{\color{red}5}$ is $\dfrac{\color{red}5}{\color{blue}3}.$ 

So, we have

$$
4\div \dfrac 3 5 = 

\dfrac 4 1 \div \dfrac{\color{blue}3}{\color{red}5} = \dfrac 4 1 \times  \dfrac{\color{red}5}{\color{blue}3}.
$$

 

Now, we multiply our fractions. 

$$
\dfrac 4 {1} \times \dfrac{5}{3} =  \dfrac {4\times 5} {1\times 3} = \dfrac{20}{3}
$$

Finally, we write the resulting improper fraction as a mixed number:

$$
\dfrac{20}{3} =6\,\textrm{R} 2 = 6\,\dfrac 2 {3}
$$
